research_scope: Publicly visible Foodpanda Singapore listing pages; three exact SFA branch joins with zero or near-empty menu coverage; extract visible names, category and displayed delivery prices only. No product descriptions, images, platform review/rating fields, or hours were copied.

outlets.branch_crosswalk: Exact address and unit match: listing footer names 10 Tampines Central 1 #B1-K20, which matches the SFA directory row and postal code. Menu table baseline has zero rows for this SFA licence.
outlets.page_observation: Foodpanda page indexed/crawled last month per search result; page displays menu categories, names and delivery prices. The rendered page’s listed current availability is dynamic; current exact capture time recorded separately.
outlets.confidence: High for branch identity and visible delivery menu values; medium for freshness because page crawl marker is last month and prices/availability change.

outlets.directory_address: Address: 33 SENGKANG WEST AVENUE #B1-06/07,THE SELETAR MALL,Singapore 797653

outlets.page_observation: Foodpanda page indexed/crawled two weeks ago per search result; rendered page displays item names and delivery prices in sections. The platform also notes prices may differ from store prices.
outlets.confidence: High for branch identity and visible delivery menu values; medium for freshness because platform crawl marker is two weeks and prices/availability change.

limitations: Foodpanda displays a delivery catalogue and explicitly states its prices may differ from in-store prices.
A page crawl marker is not the date its menu was last changed; observed_at is this research capture time.
Listings can vary with service area, operational status, promotion, options, and time; rows should be tagged delivery-only/time-sensitive.
No Mapbox calls, paid APIs, external purchases, Grab/Oddle calls, workbook edits, or Excel files were made.
Search indexing was used to find pages, then rendered page content was opened for item and price confirmation.
